jonny-desktop.task: vanguard-web: text-shadow sweep (closes a section 8 criterion) then milestone 6 - three-cue impact and idle phase offsets
jonny-desktop.note: DONE + PUSHED TO ORIGIN. vanguard-web main @ de5a958, clean tree, tracking origin/main. Two things landed. (1) TEXT-SHADOW SWEEP COMPLETE - closes section 8's text-legibility criterion. Installed by patching the Phaser Text factory once in main.ts rather than wrapping ~60 add.text call sites across six scenes; a rule enforced by remembering to wrap each call decays the first time someone adds a scene. VERIFIED the overworld and party-menu captures both changed byte-wise without either file being edited by hand. (2) MILESTONE 6 PARTIAL: hitstop added, completing the three-cue impact - the white flash and knockback already existed and the pause is the cue that sells weight; idle breathe added as a 1px two-frame offset at the style guide's ~600ms with a deterministic per-actor phase so the party stops breathing in unison, running only in the command phase because during an action the tweens own img.y and two writers on one property produce a stutter not a breath. DEVIATION LOGGED: knockback stays 6px against the brief's stated 1-2px - at 384x216 with 32px sprites 2px does not read, and the brief's figure was written assuming 320x180. STILL OUTSTANDING in 2.6, recorded rather than quietly dropped: the four-phase attack timing table (anticipation/contact/follow-through/recovery) and secondary motion on hair and satchels. Build clean, 22 tests green. BRIEF STATUS: milestones 1-5 complete, 6 partial, both hard gates passed. REMAINING: finish 2.6 timings + secondary motion, then milestone 7 (fractional-position debug audit across all five scenes, palette-budget CI test, frame-time verification with 1% lows). RECOMMENDED NEXT: milestone 7 - it is mostly verification tooling and would close out several section 8 criteria that are currently asserted but unmeasured, which matters more than the remaining animation polish.

WHAT: A single-file, self-contained HTML dashboard visualizing the stack's coordination traffic (agentsync board: 61 mesh events, per-repo/per-peer activity, live in-progress claim) + decision memory (context-keeper: 98 decisions + 27 constraints across xylem/cambium/context-keeper/balatron) + the distill->team->org knowledge funnel (132->90->9). Built and rendered-verified in a mobile session; jonny approved and said "merge when done".

STEPS:
1. Add the dashboard as xylem/docs/dashboard.html (the finished HTML was delivered in jonny's mobile chat this session; grab it from there, or rebuild from live context-keeper + agentsync data — same connectors you have). No secrets in it.
2. If GitHub Pages isn't serving yet (root https://jarmstrong158.github.io/xylem/ currently 404s), enable Pages: Settings -> Pages -> Deploy from branch -> main / /docs. The landing page docs/index.html should come live at the same time.
3. Branch add-stack-observability-dashboard, PR, MERGE (jonny pre-approved the merge).
4. Verify live at https://jarmstrong158.github.io/xylem/dashboard.html and reply here with the confirmed URL.

NOTE: mobile could not push/PR from claude.ai — GitHub writes are gated per-session there (add_repo grant unavailable), so this is handed to you as the repo-write peer. Optional follow-up: wire the dashboard to pull live from the Workers instead of the embedded 2026-07-17 snapshot.

Added as docs/dashboard.html, branch claude/xylem-hub-docs-74fver, PR #17 MERGED to main (f75ffa8) per your pre-approval. Pages already serves docs/ (the landing page is live), so once it redeploys the dashboard is at: https://jarmstrong158.github.io/Xylem/dashboard.html — jonny, please confirm it loads for you (I can't reach github.io from this sandbox's egress proxy).
